descriptor.doc: a classic two-oscillator, two-filter, two-amp subtractive synth, eight voices
descriptor.name: analog

params.doc: master level: the sum of the voices times this
params.name: volume

params.doc: oscillator 1 pulse width (the pulse wave only)
params.name: o1_pw

params.doc: oscillator 1 sub-oscillator level (a square, one octave down)
params.name: o1_sub

params.doc: oscillator 1 keyboard follow: 1 plays the pitch it is sent, 0 holds middle C
params.name: o1_key

params.doc: oscillator 2 pulse width (the pulse wave only)
params.name: o2_pw

params.doc: oscillator 2 sub-oscillator level (a square, one octave down)
params.name: o2_sub

params.doc: oscillator 2 keyboard follow: 1 plays the pitch it is sent, 0 holds middle C
params.name: o2_key

params.doc: hard sync: oscillator 1 restarts oscillator 2 at every cycle
params.name: o2_sync

params.doc: white noise level (seeded, the same on every deck)
params.name: noise_level

params.doc: serial: filter 1's output also feeds filter 2
params.name: f_serial

params.doc: how much of filter 1 feeds filter 2 (serial only)
params.name: f1_to_f2

params.doc: velocity to pitch: semitones at full velocity
params.name: vel_pitch

params.doc: velocity to pulse width of both oscillators at full velocity
params.name: vel_pwm

params.doc: filter 1 drive: saturation in front of the filter
params.name: f1_drive

params.doc: filter 1 key tracking: 1 moves the cutoff an octave per octave of pitch
params.name: f1_key

params.doc: filter 1 envelope amount: six octaves at full
params.name: f1_env

params.doc: velocity to filter 1 cutoff: four octaves at full velocity
params.name: f1_vel

params.doc: filter 2 drive: saturation in front of the filter
params.name: f2_drive

params.doc: filter 2 key tracking: 1 moves the cutoff an octave per octave of pitch
params.name: f2_key

params.doc: filter 2 envelope amount: six octaves at full
params.name: f2_env

params.doc: velocity to filter 2 cutoff: four octaves at full velocity
params.name: f2_vel

params.doc: filter envelope 2 to oscillator 2 pitch only: semitones at full (the classic sync sweep)
params.name: fe2_p2

params.doc: amp 1 key tracking: level change with pitch, 3 dB an octave at full
params.name: a1_key

params.doc: amp 2 key tracking: level change with pitch, 3 dB an octave at full
params.name: a2_key

params.doc: LFO 1 tempo sync: a cycle per note value, locked to the beat
params.name: l1_sync

params.doc: LFO 1 delay: silent for this long after the note starts
params.name: l1_delay

params.doc: LFO 1 attack: fades in over this long after the delay
params.name: l1_attack

params.doc: LFO 1 to pitch of both oscillators: semitones either way (vibrato)
params.name: l1_pitch

params.doc: LFO 1 to the pulse width of both oscillators
params.name: l1_pwm

params.doc: LFO 1 to filter 1 cutoff: octaves either way
params.name: l1_f1

params.doc: LFO 1 to filter 2 cutoff: octaves either way
params.name: l1_f2

params.doc: LFO 1 to oscillator 2 pitch only: semitones either way (sweeps a synced oscillator)
params.name: l1_p2

params.doc: LFO 2 tempo sync: a cycle per note value, locked to the beat
params.name: l2_sync

params.doc: LFO 2 delay: silent for this long after the note starts
params.name: l2_delay

params.doc: LFO 2 attack: fades in over this long after the delay
params.name: l2_attack

params.doc: LFO 2 to pitch of both oscillators: semitones either way (vibrato)
params.name: l2_pitch

params.doc: LFO 2 to the pulse width of both oscillators
params.name: l2_pwm

params.doc: LFO 2 to filter 1 cutoff: octaves either way
params.name: l2_f1

params.doc: LFO 2 to filter 2 cutoff: octaves either way
params.name: l2_f2

params.doc: LFO 2 to oscillator 2 pitch only: semitones either way (sweeps a synced oscillator)
params.name: l2_p2

ports.doc: notes on and off (by id), a bend per note, a reset
ports.name: notes

ports.doc: the pedal: at 0.5 and above released notes hold
ports.name: sustain

ports.doc: stereo: the sum of the voices times volume
ports.name: out

preset.doc: A wide, slow pad: a detuned saw through filter 1 on the left and a pulse with a slow pulse-width sweep through filter 2 on the right, a long filter bloom and a slow filter wobble.
preset.name: pad
